title: The Hunger Barn's doors read 'barred from within' and 'listen at the doors' returns the identical 'nothing... whatever is still here doesn't make sound' both before and after the grief is bargained -- coherent in hindsight (a bargain isn't a rest) but not obviously distinguished from a stale line on first encounter.
